newsitem.title: SYRIA: Syria's Assad welcomes Clinton's re-election.
newsitem.headline: Syria's Assad welcomes Clinton's re-election.

text.p: Syrian President Hafez al-Assad on Wednesday congratulated U.S. President Bill Clinton on his election victory, saying both Washington and Damascus needed to revive efforts for a just peace in the Middle East.

"With our great appreciation for the efforts you exerted during the recent years to achieve a just and comprehensive peace in our region, we expect to resume the work which we both did together during your first term," Assad said in a cable to Clinton.
Assad expressed readiness to cooperate with the U.S., under whose auspices Middle East peace talks are conducted. But he said peace in the region should be based on the land-for-peace formula.

He said talks on the Syrian-Israeli track should be conducted within the "basis of the peace process, the (U.S.) letter of assurances and the assurances you made in several occasions, especially during our first meeting in Geneva and the second in Damascus."
Assad was referring to a letter from former U.S. President George Bush in which he had said peace in the Middle should be based on U.N. resolutions 242 and 338 and the land for peace formula.
Israel occupied Syrian Golan Heights in the 1967 Arab-Israeli war and the new hardline Israeli government of Benjamin Netanyahu rejects the exchange of the strategic heights for peace with Syria.
Syria has held no talks with Israel since Netanyahu took office in June. It says Netanyahu should accept the return of the heights to Syria before the resumption of new talks.

"I hope history will record for you that your efforts greatly helped our region to reach a just and comprehensive peace on the basis of the land-for-peace which you affirmed is the basis for the peace process," Assad said in the cable, a copy of which was obtained by Reuters.
A day before American voters went to the polls, Assad praised Clinton's efforts to bring peace to the region, saying the U.S. president was honest in dealing with the issue.
